asked.item: Which number is the real one
Is something broken with the connection
Do I need to reconnect YouTube

verdict.reason: The YouTube FAQ and Analytics page explain that the lower Blotato count is expected and that no action is needed.

steps.text: For YouTube, Blotato reads the YouTube Analytics API, which reports only finalized views after YouTube filters spam and invalid traffic.
The count on the YouTube watch page updates in near real time and includes views YouTube has not validated yet, so it reads higher.
The two numbers are not expected to match, and the gap narrows as YouTube finalizes more data.
Neither delay is a bug and no action is needed.
To check this yourself, open YouTube Studio: the Analytics tab matches what Blotato reports.
